description: What flood, wildfire, and wind risk does this zip code carry? NFIP flood-insurance claims on record (count, payouts, recency, claims per 1,000 housing units), FEMA National Risk Index county scores for flood, wildfire, and wind, and recent significant storm events. Claims are history, not a forecast.
name: hazard_risk
title: Flood, wildfire, and wind risk for a zip
